title: ‘Gagged’ immigration judges return to Supreme Court, asserting ‘First Amendment black hole’

summary: Most agencies that the Pew Research Center and Gallup conducted surveys about, however, generally received positive ratings.

summary: A Senate committee aide told Government Executive that Eric Ueland’s nomination bypassed a bipartisan process for Congress to help pick the head of its own watchdog office.

title: Senate grills acting Navy secretary on Iran war costs, extended deployments
summary: Democrats in particular bristled at Hung Cao’s characterization of unsuccessful suicide attempts as “mitigations.”

title: Ueland’s GAO nomination puts Congress’s power of the purse to the test
summary: COMMENTARY | As OMB’s deputy director, Eric Ueland has been part of an administration at odds with the Government Accountability Office over its authority to withhold appropriated funds. Senators should press him on whether he will lead an independent watchdog.

title: Kupor teases department-specific Tech Force tracks

summary: At least two former feds will be members of the House next year.

summary: There aren’t any immediate signs that the outage on NSA Net is related to a cyberattack, and it may be linked to a series of software upgrades on the network.

summary: COMMENTARY | The FAA's nationwide ground stop exposed the consequences of poor agency management. The watchdog that warned of trouble needs a leader committed to its nonpartisan mission.

title: Trump taps OMB deputy to lead GAO amid rushed selection process
summary: Eric Ueland would serve a 15-year term leading the congressional watchdog that has challenged the Trump administration's spending and workforce actions.

title: OPM's plan to make feds sign NDAs faces new challenge on Capitol Hill
summary: New legislation would bar the Trump administration from using federal funds to finalize or implement the Office of Personnel Management’s proposal to require all federal workers to sign a non-disclosure agreement.

summary: While the Trump administration’s Tech Force initiative assigns young tech employees to agencies for two-year tours, the sponsor of a new House measure wants to “open the door” to longer-term service.

summary: The assistant defense secretary for special ops would rise to service-secretary level, if lawmakers allow it.

title: CDC director acknowledges employee trust is at an ‘all-time low’
summary: Dr. Erica Schwartz is trying to rebuild trust with a workforce still reeling from staffing cuts and leadership upheaval. But her remarks Thursday included another misidentification of the officer killed at CDC headquarters last year.

title: VA plans further VA.gov updates as it looks to expand AI integration

title: State Department to pilot online passport applications for first-time applicants

title: House pushes competing veterans’ benefits bills through in unusual votes

title: What retirees should know about health insurance during Open Season
summary: Federal retirement benefits expert Tammy Flanagan and Executive Editor Tanya Ballard Brown discuss what federal employees nearing retirement and current retirees should consider when choosing health coverage during Open Season.

title: Lame-duck Congress expedites search for next GAO leader

title: VA staffing losses are disrupting critical services at multiple hospitals

title: What federal agencies stand to gain by hiring more veterans
summary: COMMENTARY| The IRS has made veteran recruitment a workforce priority. Its chief human capital officer explains why military experience can be an asset across government.
